contract: ADR self-hosted-verification D8 and C9; SPEC-011 §8
owner: csarc-devops builds each image, pins it by sha256 digest, and announces updates

image.job_isolation: a new container per job, discarded when the job ends
image.log_hygiene: runner name, working directory, and hook output carry no host name, internal domain, account, or address

cache.dev: kept until the registration expires or 'csarc self-hosted retire' runs

unsupported_modules.container: needs a Docker daemon and Trivy; the VM forbids the docker socket (D8), so a repository with this module cannot verify in self-hosted mode
